title: Range Four Harry on scout craft and the speed of light

tellings.quote: ellipsoidal. One time I asked personally asked range for Harry if that craft could exceed the speed of light. He was a very nice guy. We were like brothers. He was very adamant. He said it could, but nobody, I'm going to use my words in their right mind would ever take it that fast.

plain: In the mid 1960s, in the Indian Springs Valley in Nevada, a figure Charles Hall knew as Range Four Harry is said to have told him that a small oval scout craft could go faster than light, but that nobody in their right mind would ever fly it that fast. Hall, who says he spent three years among tall white aliens near the Area 51 test ranges, tells Michels he asked Harry this himself, and that Harry was "a very nice guy" and "we were like brothers." If true, it would mean faster-than-light travel is possible and was described to an American airman.
